scope: Manual review of identity, normalization, analyzer/mono dedup, Driver check/compile result boundaries and public regression oracles. Not exact-pin qualification or a universal compiler audit.
observations: Source event identity requires a typed code and anchored primary span; message text and related wording do not select an event. Global/unanchored and uncoded diagnostics are preserved.
Normalization sorts by source file name/range/context and code rather than allocation or function/hash traversal; the lookup map is never iterated to emit diagnostics.

Duplicate event normalization retains structural cause spans, upgrades severity to error when needed, and does not allow a source event to inherit a provider-contract exemption. Related labels are ordered by location.

Public semantic-only check, check-with-session and compile-with-session normalize every returned error vector using that session source manager; public signatures and compile acceptance remain unchanged.
Move/borrow/semantic/mono dedup now compares typed identity, including distinct partial moves under Drop. Conditional-drop diagnostics attach a valid originating move when available.
Original move-state provenance join, subtree invalidation and field-cause preservation remain intact; no serialized schema, ABI, lang item, intrinsic or stdlib-name branch is added.

Regression asserts codes, counts and actual source locations, independent CLI processes, check/build parity, source/fresh-artifact parity and native valid controls; internal tests cover identity, cause union, deterministic path ordering and normalization idempotence.
